academic_regulations.credit_requirements: Total 160 credits required for B.Tech degree completion

attendance_rules.minimum_mandatory: 75.0% aggregate attendance across all registered courses in a semester.
attendance_rules.condonation_bracket: Between 65.0% and 74.99% on genuine medical/valid grounds upon payment of prescribed condonation fee and approval of Principal.
attendance_rules.detention_rule: Less than 65.0% attendance results in semester detention. The student cannot write End Semester Exams (SEE) and must repeat the semester.

evaluation_split.theory: 40 Marks Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) + 60 Marks Semester End Examination (SEE)
evaluation_split.practical_lab: 40 Marks Continuous Lab Evaluation + 60 Marks External Lab Examination
evaluation_split.passing_criteria: Minimum 35% in SEE and 40% aggregate (CIE + SEE) in each course.

training_programs: Competitive Coding & Data Structures Bootcamps (LeetCode / CodeChef)
Full-Stack MERN & Java Spring Boot Training

library.digital_facilities: High-speed internet access nodes, NPTEL video repository, Delnet, Knimbus remote access platform
